name: genesisgradelens
description: See inside your child's Genesis grades: breakdowns, checks, and what-if projections.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/GenesisGradeLens && cp -R dist/. release/GenesisGradeLens/ && cd release && zip -qr GenesisGradeLens.zip GenesisGradeLens
scripts.build:web: tsc --noEmit && vite build -c vite.site.config.ts && vite build -c vite.web.config.ts
scripts.preview:web: npm run build:web && python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory site
